_about: The Story page's two PATHS, one per project format (a feature and a short film are not the same road, and the page never mixes them). Read by src/lib/story.js (PATH, pathProgress, hash mapping), src/pages/story.js (which draws every step on the page, in this order) and src/ui/stage-guide.js (which leaves out of the Story Guide every blueprint step a path step already asks). Nothing here is stored. A step is { id, label, n, absorbs }. `n` is the step's STABLE NUMBER for old #path-N links (1 idea, 2 logline, 3 structure, 4 outline, 5 synopsis, 6 screenplay, 7 bible; steps added later take 8 and up) — never renumber one. `absorbs` lists the blueprint questions the step asks INLINE, so each question is on the page once: "<ns>:<step id>" is the whole step; "<ns>:<step id>#rest" is the step WITHOUT its questions (its formula, craft, examples, relationship map and 'before moving on' checklist stay) because the Story Bible's own cards — see `cards` — ask them; "<ns>:treatment-ladder#<key>" is one rung of the ladder. `cards` names the Story Bible cards a step shows (src/data/story-bible.json). Every data-key of the blueprint steps that sit in the Story stage must be reachable here or in the Guide's cover; scripts/test-story.mjs asserts it.
